## 5. Statistical Code Paths Audited

Audited `evaluation_step11.py`, `step11_finalize_statistics.py`, `step11_primary_evaluation.py`, and the independent Step 11.1 implementation. Covered grouping, replacement, duplicate clusters, seed aggregation, percentiles, macro-F1, undefined rank metrics, AURC, contrasts, interactions, APS, calibration transfer, and signed gaps.

## 6. Subject Bootstrap Semantics

Uniform subject indices with replacement, RNG seed `2028`; every draw appends all epochs for that subject. Duplicate draws duplicate the full cluster. Common draw sequences are used across seeds and paired conditions; source and target are sampled separately.

## 7. Duplicate-Cluster Multiplicity Test

PASS. Synthetic `[A,A,C]` reconstructed `A+A+C` and differed from collapsed `A+C`.

## 8. Identity-Sample Invariant

PASS for all 36 bundles and all required metrics. Maximum absolute difference was `8.8817841970012523e-16`.

## 9. Subject / Epoch Alignment Across Seeds

PASS: 36/36 bundles share subject sets, recording/epoch keys, per-subject counts, and population-specific condition keys. Sleep-EDF person clusters and ISRUC recording attachments remain bundle-stable.

## 10. Multi-Seed Point Estimate Audit

PASS. Every point is the mean of independently recomputed seed metrics; no cross-seed probability/logit averaging. Nine requested reference cases are stored in `step11_1_qa_summary.json`.

## 11. Multi-Seed Bootstrap Audit

PASS after repair. Each replicate uses the same subject sequence across seeds, reconstructs each seed separately, computes its metric, then averages metrics.

## 13. Percentile Calculation Audit

PASS: exactly 2,000 finite values, NumPy 2.5/97.5 percentiles, no 5/95 substitution, axis error, percentage mismatch, or silent NaN removal.

## 14. Fixed-Class Macro-F1 Audit

PASS. Fixed `[Wake,N1,N2,N3,REM]` classes, zero F1 for absent classes under the frozen zero-division policy; no class-list shrinkage.

## 15. AUROC/AUPRC Undefined-Replicate Audit

PASS. Undefined count was 0 for every primary AUROC/AUPRC row; all had 2,000 finite replicates.

## 16. AURC Audit

PASS. Uncertainty ascending, risk `1-accuracy`, stable tie order, frozen prefix-mean integration. Synthetic risks `[0,0.5,1/3]` produced `0.2777777777777778`.

## 17. Known-Domain Paired Contrast Audit

PASS. C0/C1/C2 share each SOURCE TEST draw; corrected EEG-only/full and EOG-only/full contrasts are in v1.1.

## 18. Unseen-Domain Paired Contrast Audit

PASS. C3/C4/C5 share each COMPLETE TARGET draw; duplicate clusters retain multiplicity.

## 19. Domain × Modality Interaction Audit

PASS. SOURCE TEST and TARGET draws are independent; pairing is preserved within each population only.

## 20. Calibration-Transfer Contrast Audit

PASS read-only audit. Frozen logits/labels/bundle identities are shared; only serialized temperature transformation differs. NLL, Brier, and ECE paths were inspected; no T was refit.

## 21. APS Calibration Audit

PASS. Frozen cumulative-probability score, deterministic tie rule, and finite-sample k rule were reproduced; every qhat95 ≥ qhat90.

## 22. APS Set-Construction Audit

PASS. Boundary equality is included, ties are probability-descending/class-index ascending, and top class is always retained.

## 23. APS Monotonicity / Nesting Audit

PASS for all 36 bundles: 95% sets contain 90% sets, are non-empty, and have no lower coverage or mean size.

## 24. Conformal Gap Semantic Clarification

Values are unchanged. Zero is ideal; positive nominal-minus-empirical means undercoverage; negative means overcoverage. Authoritative orientation: `zero_is_ideal_signed_gap`.

## 25. Independent Metric Recomputation

PASS for D1 C0/C3/C5 references and D2 C0/C3/C4/C5 references requested. Seed-level values and points are in `step11_1_qa_summary.json`.

## 26. Root Cause

`step11_finalize_statistics.py` computed subject-level metrics and then applied `np.nanmean(sv[:, sample_idx], axis=2)`. This collapses replacement multiplicity and does not compute metrics over duplicated epoch clusters. It also used seed-17 qhats for conformal bootstrap values instead of each seed's frozen qhat. The prediction bundles and primary point estimates were not defective; the v1 bootstrap summaries were.


## 27. Statistical Repair

Only post-processing was repaired: epoch-level cluster multiplicity, common seed/condition draws, per-seed frozen qhats, frozen seed `2028`, and frozen count `2,000` were retained. New artifacts are `b0_primary_results_multiseed_v1_1.csv`, `b0_primary_contrasts_v1_1.csv`, `b0_statistical_hashes_v1_1.txt`, `step11_1_bootstrap_diagnostics.csv`, and `bootstrap_replicates_v1_1.npz`.
